name: Developments in Literacy
mission: Developments in Literacy (DIL) delivers transformative education to underserved children in Pakistan—especially girls—by operating high-quality schools, empowering local educators, and innovating technology solutions to ensure that every child succeeds.
theoryOfChange: DIL was founded in an effort to educate children and thereby empower communities. Our low-cost, high-quality education prepares students to chart the future of their country in fields as diverse as medicine, engineering, and public service. DIL focuses on engaging with communities who are active stakeholders in the change process, particularly the need to increase literacy among girls and women. DIL also aims to deploy technology in the service of intellectual growth in students as well as professional skill-building in teachers. Further, the DIL Gateway Initiative addresses challenges that prevent many graduates from using their education to expand their life choices, developing programs that ready graduates for success beyond school walls, including in higher education, jobs, and entrepreneurial opportunities. DIL's ultimate goal is to produce long-term, sustainable change in the lives of students and generate measurable change in attitudes toward education.

strengths_deep_dive: Developments in Literacy combines high direct efficiency with institutional transparency. By directing <cite id="1">90.5% of total expenses to educational programming</cite>, the vast majority of donor contributions fund school facilities, teacher development, and technology in Pakistan. Furthermore, the organization operates with minimal overhead, maintaining a <cite id="1">fundraising expense ratio of only $0.05 per $1 raised</cite>. Independent evaluators consistently recognize this operational strength, awarding DIL <cite id="1">a perfect 100.0/100 from Charity Navigator rating</cite> and a Candid Platinum Seal of Transparency.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1997, Developments in Literacy (DIL) provides high-quality, free education to underserved children in Pakistan, with a strong emphasis on empowering young girls. Operating <cite id="15">214 schools</cite> that serve nearly 90,000 students, DIL focuses on community-driven education, EdTech Integration, and extensive teacher development. The organization demonstrates exceptional financial stewardship, committing <cite id="1">90.5% of expenses to program operations</cite> and spending just <cite id="1">$0.05 per $1 raised</cite> in public support. In FY2024, the charity brought in <cite id="4">$2,785,991 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting steady growth and fiscal discipline. DIL also accepts <cite id="2">zakat donations</cite> directed toward student and community relief. The charity maintains the highest transparency standards, holding <cite id="1">a 100/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> along with a Candid Platinum Seal.
